queries.sparql: SELECT ?execution ?queryGroup ?status ?started ?ended WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:actual-execution> { ?execution a <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Activity> ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:queryGroup> ?queryGroup ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:status> ?status ; <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#startedAtTime> ?started . OPTIONAL { ?execution <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#endedAtTime> ?ended } } } ORDER BY ?started ?queryGroup

SELECT ?trace ?candidate ?revision ?assertedRole ?selectedRole ?decision ?reason WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:qualification> { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:candidate> ?candidate ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:candidateRevision> ?revision ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:assertedRole> ?assertedRole ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:decision> ?decision ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason . OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:selectedRole> ?selectedRole } } } ORDER BY ?candidate ?assertedRole

SELECT ?trace ?role ?required ?condition ?conditionResult ?state ?reason WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:qualification> { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:role> ?role ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:required> ?required ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:state> ?state ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason . OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:condition> ?condition } OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:conditionResult> ?conditionResult } } } ORDER BY ?role

SELECT ?transition ?subject ?from ?to ?reason ?source WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:reasons> { ?transition <urn:chronicle:predicate:subject> ?subject ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:toState> ?to ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:source> ?source . OPTIONAL { ?transition <urn:chronicle:predicate:fromState> ?from } } } ORDER BY ?transition
